text:
Priya (People Ops): Sharing a compact manager quickstart for new hires (preboard + week0). Please skim and flag gaps. Alex can you confirm owners for tech vs security?

Alex (Hiring Manager): Nice concise format. Two asks: call out who approves KMS/SSO and add 3 simple week-1 success metrics we can track.

Priya (People Ops): Noted. Security/CIO (Sam) approves SSO/KMS. Week-1 metrics suggestion: 1) dev env green within 48h, 2) first small PR merged, 3) 10-15m intro at team sync.

Sam (IT): I'll own imaging + access approvals. Typical timeline: order D-3, image D-1, provision accounts D0-AM. Internal commands we use: 
```ncreate_user --email tina@redwood.ai --team eng
mdm-enroll --serial S/N
gh invite --org redwood-inference --team eng tina@redwood.ai
```
Ping me if invites don't arrive within 4 business hours. Loaner flow: request in #it-ops, we allocate same-day if stock.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Proposed week0 sprint (tight):
Day 0 AM: welcome + accounts check + 1:1
Day 0 PM: clone repos, run smoke build
Day 1: finish env, run tests, small bug task assigned
Day 2: pair on task, open PR
Day 3: architecture walk (30m) + infra runbook (15m)
Day 4: PR review + 15m team intro presentation
Add a required measurable: "local smoke test passing within 48h."

Priya (People Ops): Compact 30/60/90 template (paste into 1:1):
30d: baseline knowledge, 1 merged PR, update a doc
60d: own a minor feature, reduce a setup friction point
90d: ship a measurable improvement (perf or reliability) and present outcomes
Assign one mentor/owner per bullet.

Alex (Hiring Manager): I'll assign Jordan as tech mentor and Maria as buddy. Tina, do 9:30 PT standups work? We use async notes in #eng-standup.

Tina (New Hire): 9:30 PT fine. Quick Q: when will GitHub org access arrive and where are the canonical onboarding docs?

Sam (IT): Usually same-day when added to team. If blocked, DM me with repo path. Canonical docs: Confluence at https://confluence.redwood.ai/eng/onboarding and handbook repo https://github.com/redwood-inference/handbook

Priya (People Ops): Manager preboard checklist (things to do before day 0): confirm signed forms, equipment order + ETA, share first-week schedule with hire, set placeholder 30/60/90 meetings, draft announcement.

Alex (Hiring Manager): Draft announcement I'll post Monday: "Welcome Tina, Senior ML Engineer focused on inference runtime optimization. Mentor: Jordan. Buddy: Maria. Drop a quick hello! :tada:" Edits?

Jordan (Eng Manager): Add a security micro-brief (15m) on Day 2 with @security-team and an infra orientation (30m). Also add calendar invites: day2 infra (30m) and day7 retro (15m).

Priya (People Ops): Manager day0 checklist to confirm: equipment delivered or loaner arranged, Slack/email/VPN access, calendar invites (manager, mentor, buddy), welcome post scheduled, benefits enrollment started.

Tina (New Hire): If laptop delayed I'll request a loaner. Can I get the 30/60/90 doc to prepare?

Sam (IT): Loaner yes—request in #it-ops. Priya: can you share the editable template?

Priya (People Ops): Sent Google doc link to manager, mentor, and new hire. Also adding a one-paragraph manager tip to the runbook: keep week0 focused, measurable, and timeboxed; favor short check-ins over long read-heavy sessions.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled -> "post welcome in #general" on 2026-06-01T09:00:00Z

Alex (Hiring Manager): Final owners: Hardware & imaging: Sam; Accounts & SSO approvals: Sam; Employment forms & benefits: Priya; Role context & intro: Alex; Technical mentorship: Jordan; Buddy/check-ins: Maria. I'll post announcement Monday after Sam confirms accounts.

Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll create invites now. If anyone wants tweaks, add to Confluence runbook and tag @Priya.

Tina (New Hire): Thanks everyone, excited to join! See you Monday :raised_hands:
